posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
Have you ever used the TRIAL version (not through STEAM)?
If so, the problem is probably with STEAM, but I can list some possible causes for this type of problem, regardless of the software you're trying to open:
Windows compromised by previous software installation, especially cracks
Your antivirus module may be considering a standard DLL compromised despite not reporting it to the user (this is common with free antivirus programs. In this case, it's best to use Defender)
HDD/SSD with sector problems
Processor or RAM that are unable to perform necessary operations due to exceeding the limit within a given address (This last one is unlikely unless it's an older computer)
Another older thread with a very similar problem and a possible solution:

posts.author: sbloom85
posts.body:
I have tried the trial version outside of Steam and had the same result. I used this launch option "--disable-gpu" and that ended up working.
CPU: Ryzen 7 3700X
GPU: Radeon RX 7800XT
RAM: 2x G.Skill Aegis DDR4 3000 16GB
OS: Windows 11
The application is on an SSD and all other items on the SSD works just fine.
Edit: After using that option and creating a new project, the application works perfectly.
